setup.antennas: 40 transmitters at radius 4, 60 receivers at radius 4.5 (book rings)

formulas.fisher: F = (2 / s^2) Re(D^H D), D = [dd/dp_k] = jvp of the forward map along the exact shape derivative d chi / d p_k
formulas.noise: s^2 = mean|d_clean|^2 10^(-SNR/10), circular complex Gaussian, E|e|^2 = s^2
formulas.scaling: F(SNR) = F(30 dB) 10^((SNR - 30)/10); sigma_CRB(SNR) = sigma_CRB(30 dB) 10^(-(SNR - 30)/20)
formulas.required_snr: SNR_req(g) = 30 + 20 log10(sigma_CRB(30 dB) / g), sigma_CRB(g) <= g (Smith 2005)
formulas.born_ratio: info_ratio_known = F_gg / F_gg(Born); info_ratio_unknown = (sigma_CRB,Born / sigma_CRB)^2, both at the noise level of the full model
formulas.born_ratio_matched: info_ratio_*_matched = info_ratio_* x P_Born / P_full: each model at its own power SNR (s^2 = mean|d|^2 10^(-SNR/10))
formulas.local_regime: the bound at SNR_req is read as local if sd(r)/r and sd(eps_r)/(eps_r - 1) at that SNR are both <= 0.1; otherwise sigma_CRB(g) = g there is a lower bound of unknown tightness, not a required SNR

book_claims.source: Campbell and Werner (eds.), Advances in Electromagnetics Empowered by AI and DL, Ch. 15, Sec. 15.4.2.1, pp. 464-467
